SELECT s.trade_id, s.seller_id, s.title, s.price_point, s.max_mileage_use, s.quantity, s.thumb_img, s.recommend_cnt, s.status, s.regdate,
s.allow_full_mileage,
m.nickname AS seller_nickname, t.toplct_name
FROM saletrade_board s JOIN member m ON s.seller_id = m.member_id JOIN top_location t ON s.toplct_id = t.toplct_id
WHERE s.is_deleted = 'N' AND m.enable_flag = '1' AND m.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.seller_status = 'Y'
ORDER BY s.regdate DESC
